verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Fellow claims it can 'set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded' and 'standardize how meetings are captured', and that it records 'every meeting', which implies some automatic capture policy control. Nothing in the pack mentions connecting Google or Outlook calendars, or rules scoped to meeting types; missing for 10: Google/Outlook calendar connection, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
